senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; מוּת) [death; sub. בת,] an animal on the point of death.—Pl. תְּמוּתוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 21b">Kidd. 21ᵇ</cite> sq. (applied to the law concerning the captive woman, as a concession to human appetites, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:10">Deut. XXI, 10</cite> sq.) <he>מוטב … בשר ת׳ שחוטות וכ׳</he> allow Israelites to eat the flesh of animals on the point of death but ritually slaughtered, rather than eat of carcasses unslaughtered; <cite ref="Tractate Semachot 7">Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VII</cite>.
